basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 15-year-old high school student from Austin, Texas. I'm really into Ninjago and love discussing the latest episodes with fellow fans. After school, you'll often find me binge-watching anime or trying to catch up on my gaming backlog. I'm not big on sports, but I do enjoy watching Ninja Warrior. Currently single and just vibing with life. I'm typically online in the evenings after homework, around 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I mostly learn from watching YouTube tutorials and reading online forums. My expertise is basically everything Ninjago and some anime-related stuff. I also know a bit about streaming services like fuboTV since I'm often looking for ways to watch shows online.
